lines.speaker: Vin
lines.text: The city's awake. And he's still healing faster than I can hurt him. Every wound closes the moment it opens.

lines.speaker: Vin
lines.text: Forty years and never once without the bracers. He isn't unkillable. He's storing it — and wearing it.

lines.speaker: Vin
lines.text: Make him overreach. Wait for him to stumble. Then iron, and pull.
